title: Prepare your service desk and open the customer list
goal: Prepare a separate small practice application without BSL or changing the preceding infobase.
prerequisites: Create an empty infobase and distinguish Designer from Enterprise mode.
outcomes: Download the original .cf separately from the platform.
Load it into a new empty personal infobase and apply the update.
Open Customers and continue in the same infobase after reopening.
sections: Why a prepared configuration is useful

The introductory empty infobase helped identify windows but has no application lists yet. Customer entry requires a catalog definition. Our small original Training service desk supplies Customers, Services and Service request. It includes no real data or third-party application. Writing BSL is unnecessary for the first customer card.

A configuration is not the platform. First install the official training platform from its source; separately download NexusTrainingServiceDeskV2.cf using the lab-guide button. Do not run this file as an installer: load it through Designer into your own infobase.
A new location for the new practice

Create another startup entry without a configuration, name it Training service desk — practice and choose a new separate directory. Do not load into the introductory infobase. Before launch distinguish similar entries by their registered directories; different copies can display the same configuration title.

The .cf contains structure, not every customer from another infobase. Loading it changes the selected application definition. Establish that the target is new and empty first; otherwise cancel and return to the startup list.

Open Designer from the verified new entry. Select Configuration → Load configuration from file and choose the .cf. Then Update database configuration (usually F7), read the changes and wait. Start Enterprise mode after completion.

Find the Учебная сервисная служба section and Клиенты command; placement can vary with version. Opening the list creates no customer. It is empty in a new infobase. The next lesson creates the first card and verifies it survives reopening.

Each day open the same practice entry. Reloading .cf is not normal continuation and can affect structural edits. Use .dt for data backup and a separate restoration check. Keep a short note identifying your infobase, lesson and next action.

Nexus knows the selected lesson and saved local position, but does not automatically inspect external 1C. For an empty list check the entry, directory and search first. The engineering stand with seeded test records is a separate experiment; its numbers and totals do not replace observations of your new infobase.

lab.title: A prepared application in a new personal infobase
lab.environment: Normally installed official training platform and the original .cf linked by Nexus.
steps: Download Training service desk — configuration, named NexusTrainingServiceDeskV2.cf. Save it in a known directory. Do not unpack .cf or install it as a program.
Create Training service desk — practice without a configuration on this computer in a new directory. Verify its entry and directory before launch.

Choose Load configuration from file and select the downloaded .cf. Answer Yes to Update database configuration if prompted; otherwise run the update (F7). Inspect the changes: Клиенты, Услуги, ЗаявкаУслуги and СтатусыЗаявки are added without deleting earlier objects. Choose Accept and wait.
Open Учебная сервисная служба → Клиенты. Create no cards yet; note the empty starting state.
Close your application normally and reopen the same startup entry → Enterprise → Customers. Note that creating the first customer is next.
expected: The .cf is available and the platform was installed separately.
Practice has its own new directory.
The tree contains Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги and the update completes.
The list opens again and introductory work remains separate.
evidence: Purpose of the practice infobase and availability of its list.
lab.negative: Cancel loading into an unidentified or already-used infobase before changing it; choose a new empty one.

mistakes: Load it using Designer; install the platform separately.
I reload the template every day.
Open the same infobase to continue; loading does not substitute for data saving.

quiz.question: How is the training .cf used?
options: Load it in Designer into a new empty infobase
quiz.explanation: A configuration is a definition; install the platform separately.

quiz.question: Which target is appropriate for this lab?
options: A new empty infobase in a verified separate directory
quiz.explanation: Preserve earlier work separately; a window title is insufficient.

quiz.question: How do you continue tomorrow?
options: Create a new infobase and reload the template each time
quiz.explanation: Continuation uses the persisted state of the same instance.

review: Distinguish the platform from the downloaded .cf.
Explain why a new directory is required.
Next, create and reopen the first customer card.

steps.title: Obtain the training definition
steps.where: Nexus → How to complete the lab
steps.action: Download Training service desk — configuration, named NexusTrainingServiceDeskV2.cf. Save it in a known directory. Do not unpack .cf or install it as a program.
steps.why: The separate file contains only our original application definition.
steps.expected: The .cf is available and the platform was installed separately.
steps.troubleshooting: If an HTML file or an unknown archive was downloaded, do not rename it to .cf; return to the course link.

steps.title: Create an empty practice target

steps.expected: Practice has its own new directory.

steps.before: The .cf is available and the platform was installed separately.

steps.title: Load the configuration
steps.action: Choose Load configuration from file and select the downloaded .cf. Answer Yes to Update database configuration if prompted; otherwise run the update (F7). Inspect the changes: Клиенты, Услуги, ЗаявкаУслуги and СтатусыЗаявки are added without deleting earlier objects. Choose Accept and wait.
steps.why: The application must use the loaded definition.
steps.expected: The tree contains Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги and the update completes.
